sources.primary_title: Saudi Passports Directorate launches easy resident photo update on Absher
sources.verified_angle_summary: The General Directorate of Passports in Saudi Arabia has introduced a new digital service allowing residents to update their personal photos directly through the Absher app. This move is part of the broader digital transformation initiatives often showcased at major tech events like LEAP 2026. The service eliminates the need for expatriates to visit passport offices in person for photo updates, streamlining the process through the "My Workers" section on the Absher platform. This concrete launch demonstrates the ongoing expansion of e-government services in the Kingdom, providing a specific, verifiable angle for coverage that highlights practical improvements in administrative processes for residents.
